days.title: Northern Bays and Main Town
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Binnenmüritz
stops.detail: At the town of Waren (Müritz) in the north of the lake is the Binnenmüritz with the lake's deepest point (−31 m), which has only a narrow connection to the main basin of the Müritz.

stops.name: Waren (Müritz)
stops.detail: The largest town on the Müritz is Waren (Müritz).

days.title: Western Shores and National Park
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Müritz-Nationalpark
stops.detail: In the east, the Müritz National Park, Germany's largest terrestrial national park, borders the lake.

stops.name: Röbel/Müritz
stops.detail: Other towns are (clockwise) Rechlin, Priborn, Vipperow, Ludorf, Röbel/Müritz, Gotthun, Sietow and Klink.

stops.name: Großer Schwerin
stops.detail: The peninsulas of Großer Schwerin and Steinhorn and their surroundings in the southwest, as well as the Müritz steep bank near Rechlin in the southeast of the lake, are designated as nature reserves.
